note: dc-qalink 0.2 gate, base Flycast suite: the loop through the pinned relay, then the bridge, live data and MCP. Rows marked control must fail the way they say.

rows.name: 02-ret
rows.what: straight back, no link (the stub's way back)

rows.name: 03-push-run
rows.what: push, verify, run with the link up, 5 lines, back

rows.name: 04-report
rows.what: a long report (20 lines, 6,000 bytes) back intact

rows.name: 05-screen-x3
rows.what: three grabs of the screen in video memory

rows.name: 06-crash
rows.what: a crash comes back to the loader with its report

rows.name: 07-reset
rows.what: RESET from the PC 5 s into a waiting program

rows.name: 08-restart-way-back
rows.what: the restart way back: a BIOS reboot (disc switch), the run's hand-off kept

rows.name: 09-control-corrupt
rows.what: control: a corrupted image is refused and nothing runs

rows.name: 10-control-reboot
rows.what: control: a plain reboot with no ending comes back with the run named LOST
rows.ruling: 2026-11-22 (integrator): since the full restart, a reboot with no ending comes back named LOST (rc 5); the old rc 4 lives on as ret nosave

rows.name: 11-status
rows.what: the loader still answers after every row

rows.name: 21-live-base
rows.what: live data on: the example scene 20 s through the bridge

rows.name: 22-live-slow
rows.what: the same with a planted 2 ms delay (the measuring control)

rows.name: 23-control-planted-2ms
rows.what: control: the planted 2 ms reads as 2 ms in Drawing

rows.name: 24-mcp
rows.what: the local MCP with a real MCP client: 9 of 9 (two controls inside)
